source: segmentation (Blender simulation, background replaced by white)
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale guessed

blank_frames.note: fully black (end of render); no objects visible

camera.motion: static (the player stands in the same pixels to within 1-2 px for frames 54-127; there are no background features because the background is plain white)
camera.perspective_cues: none visible: no ground, horizon or vanishing points. Depth cue is only the apparent size: ball diameter ~35.1 px in flight (frames 24-78, constant to within 1 px, so near-constant camera distance), ~33.4 px after it drops through the hoop (frames 101-127), so the ball is ~5% farther from the camera there than at release. The player is ~217 px tall (head top to soles) standing.
camera.focal_length: unknown; estimate from the given depth_info plus a known size: f_px = size_px * depth / size_world

objects.name: ball
objects.description: basketball, red/maroon, the only round red object; apparent diameter ~35 px (flight), ~33.4 px (after the hoop)
objects.visible_frames: 0-94 (0-23 held in hands, 79-94 bottom part hidden behind the invisible hoop rim), hidden 95-99, 100-127 visible (100 partly covered by net holes)

objects.name: player
objects.description: basketball player, black jersey number 23 and black shorts, dark skin, face blanked (light grey), white shoes; the only person; stands around x~1230
objects.visible_frames: 0-127 (lower body missing from the segmentation in frames 42-53)
objects.reference_point: pelvis proxy (pelvis_x, pelvis_y): y = head_top + 0.47*(feet_y - head_top), x = mask mean in that row band; also bbox, centroid, head_top_y, feet_y, foot positions

crouched_frame_0.note: knees bent, holding the ball at waist height

objects.name: hoop (invisible)
objects.description: the hoop/rim and net are not drawn (removed with the background), but they hide the ball: the ball is cut along a horizontal edge at y~493-499 for x~695-740 in frames 79-94, is fully hidden in 95-99, and net strands make holes in the ball at frame 100 (net fragments visible at y 502-540)
objects.reliability: inferred only from where the ball disappears; rim width unknown (> ball width 35 px)

objects.name: floor (invisible)
objects.description: not drawn; implied by the ball bounce (ball lowest centre y 760.9-762.2, bottom ~778-780) and the player's soles at y~799 (the player is nearer the camera than the bounce point)

events.event: start: player crouched, holding the ball at waist height, nearly still
player starts to rise from the crouch (bbox top / pelvis move up)
ball raised above head (set point), ball nearly still at x~1210-1215, y~560
release: last frame the ball touches the hand = 23, first frame the ball is a separate blob = 24
player's left foot is off the bottom band (one foot lifted / small hop); feet_y highest (smallest y) 786 at frame 33 vs 799 standing
events.reliability: ambiguous whether this is a real jump

events.event: ball apex in image (minimum cy 447.2; cy within 1 px of that over frames 51-60)
player lowers arms / follow-through ends; standing still from here
ball reaches the rim: bottom starts to be hidden
ball fully hidden in the hoop/net
ball hits the floor (lowest cy 760.9) = bounce

files.tracks/ball_stage1.csv, tracks/player_st: intermediate outputs of scripts/track2.py (ball.csv/player.csv derive from them)
files.summary_stats.json: apparent ball diameter stats, hoop edge, apex, player standing size
